About Chroma

A different kind of
paint brand.

Across Nigeria, most painting jobs end in frustration. Wrong colours, missed timelines, sites left in a mess. Chroma by Tetrux was built specifically for homeowners who are done settling for that.


We combine expert colour knowledge with precise, clean execution. You see your space in your chosen colour before we open a single tin of paint. Every detail confirmed. Every shade approved.


The result is a home that looks exactly the way you imagined. Delivered on time. Finished properly. Backed by a warranty.

What We Do

Two ways to work
with Chroma.

Whether you need the full painting service or just expert colour guidance, we have a package built for you.

Our Services

Expertise at every
level of your project.

Whether you need end-to-end painting or just a sharp colour plan to brief your own contractor, Chroma has the right service.

🖌
Chroma Colour & Paint

Our full-service offering. We handle colour consultation, colour visualisation, surface preparation, primer, full paint application, and clean-up. You approve before we begin. We deliver on time.

  • Full colour consultation and visualisation
  • Surface prep and premium primer
  • Minimum 2 finishing coats (more if needed)
  • Daily site clean-up and furniture protection
  • 6-month touch-up warranty on completion
  • 50/50 payment structure
Starting from NGN 80,000 / room
🎯
Chroma Colour Consult

Expert colour strategy without the full painting service. Perfect if you have your own contractor but want to make sure the colours are right. We visit, we analyse, we deliver a clear colour brief.

  • On-site colour consultation (1–2 hrs)
  • Space, light and lifestyle analysis
  • Curated colour palette recommendations
  • Detailed colour brief for your contractor
  • One revision round included
  • Optional follow-up visit available
Starting from NGN 30,000 – 50,000

How It Works

Our 7-step
process.

01Initial Enquiry
02Free Site Visit
03Colour Strategy
04Quote & Approval
05Mobilisation
06Execution
07Handover
01
Initial Enquiry
Reach out via WhatsApp, Instagram, or our contact form. Tell us the type of job, the location, and your rough timeline. We respond within 2 hours, every time.
WhatsApp · Instagram · Form
02
Free Site Visit
We come to you at no charge. Our colour specialist walks through the space, assesses the light at different times of day, asks about your lifestyle and preferences. No obligations. Just information.
Free · No Obligation
03
Colour Strategy
Based on the site visit, we build a bespoke colour palette for your home. We map specific shades to specific rooms and show you what the space will look like before a single tin is opened.
Visualised · Tailored
04
Quote & Approval
You receive a fully itemised quote with the colour plan, materials list, timeline, and the 50/50 payment structure explained. Nothing moves until you sign off on everything in writing.
Transparent · Written
05
Mobilisation
On receipt of the first payment, we procure your specific paints and materials. We brief the dedicated on-site team, assign a senior, and confirm the exact start date with you 48 hours in advance.
Dedicated Team · Senior On-Site
06
Execution
The team arrives uniformed and on time. Furniture is protected. Surfaces prepped. Two or more coats applied room by room. The site is cleaned daily. You are updated at every stage.
Daily Updates · Clean Site
07
Handover
We do a formal walk-through with you. Any touch-up required is done on the spot before we consider the job complete. You receive your 6-month warranty documentation. Final payment is made. Job done.
6-Month Warranty · Walk-Through

Our Story

Built for homeowners
who expect more.

Chroma by Tetrux was founded on one conviction: Nigerian homeowners deserve a painting service that actually delivers.

6-Month WarrantyStandard on every Chroma job

About Chroma

A different kind of
paint brand.

Across Nigeria, most painting jobs end in frustration. Wrong colours, missed timelines, sites left in a mess. Chroma by Tetrux was built specifically for homeowners who are done settling for that.


We combine expert colour knowledge with precise, clean execution. You see your space in your chosen colour before we open a single tin of paint. Every detail confirmed. Every shade approved.


The result is a home that looks exactly the way you imagined. Delivered on time. Finished properly. Backed by a warranty.

Our Team

Equipped.
On every site.

Our team arrives uniformed, fully kitted, and ready to work. Every job is assigned a dedicated team with a senior on site from day one through to handover.

Field Team

Uniformed, kitted, and professional on every site. Our painters are trained in surface prep, primer application, and finish work to the Chroma standard.

Ceiling Specialists

Ceilings are where most painters cut corners. Our team treats every ceiling with the same precision as the feature wall. Every coat. Every time.

Interior Finish Team

Clean lines, smooth roller coverage, and no bleed on trims. Our interior painters take the time to prep right so the finish stays perfect long after we leave.

Exterior Team

Exterior jobs require height work, weatherproof materials, and precise facade management. Our exterior team is experienced on residential builds from bungalows to multi-storey estates.

Where We Operate

Serving Nigeria,
city by city.

Active Market
Lagos

Our primary base. We serve all major residential corridors: Lekki, Ikoyi, Victoria Island, Banana Island, Magodo, Ikeja GRA, and Ajah. Full service available with 2-day mobilisation.

LekkiIkoyiVictoria IslandBanana IslandMagodo
Active Market
Abuja

Serving Maitama, Asokoro, Wuse 2, Guzape, and Jabi. Our Abuja team operates independently with the same standards, same materials, and same warranty structure as Lagos.

MaitamaAsokoroWuse 2Guzape
Active Market
Port Harcourt

GRA, Trans Amadi, and the new residential estates in the Elelenwo corridor. Port Harcourt is a growing market for us and we are investing in building local team capacity here.

GRATrans AmadiElelenwo
Expanding
West Africa

We are actively exploring expansion across West Africa, beginning with Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire. If you are outside Nigeria and interested in Chroma, get in touch. We want to hear from you.

GhanaCôte d'IvoireComing Soon

Our Parent Company

Tetrux
Building the infrastructure for quality living across Africa

Chroma is part of the Tetrux group — a holding company building quality-driven brands across the home and lifestyle space in Africa. Tetrux businesses share a single standard: do the thing properly or do not do it at all. That philosophy is the foundation Chroma was built on.
